description: Canonical feature schema for GigScore. Shared contract between M1, M2, and M3 pipelines.

income.description: Income volume, stability, and trend derived from Account Aggregator transaction data.

monthly_income_avg.description: 3-month rolling average of net credited income across all platforms.

monthly_income_std.description: Standard deviation of monthly net income over the last 3 months.

income_volatility.description: Coefficient of variation of monthly income (monthly_income_std / monthly_income_avg). High values indicate unstable earnings.

income_growth_rate.description: Month-over-month income growth rate. Null if fewer than 2 months of data are available.

income_trend.description: OLS slope of monthly income over the last 6 months. Positive indicates growing income.

income_per_active_day.description: Average income earned per day on which at least one gig was completed.

activity.description: Platform engagement and work regularity metrics.

active_day_ratio.description: Fraction of calendar days with at least one completed gig in the last 90 days.

active_days_per_month.description: Average number of active working days per calendar month over the last 90 days.

longest_inactive_gap.description: Longest continuous streak of days with no gig activity in the last 90 days.

platform_tenure_months.description: Number of months since the worker's first verified transaction on any linked platform.

gigs_per_week.description: Average number of completed gigs per calendar week over the last 90 days.

multi_platform_count.description: Number of distinct gig platforms on which the worker has earned income in the last 90 days.

service_quality.description: Customer satisfaction and delivery reliability signals from platform APIs.

average_rating.description: Weighted average customer rating across all platforms on a 1–5 scale. Null if no ratings are available.

rating_trend.description: OLS slope of monthly average rating over the last 6 months. Null if fewer than 2 months of ratings exist.

completion_rate.description: Fraction of accepted gigs completed successfully (not cancelled after acceptance).

cancellation_rate.description: Fraction of accepted gigs cancelled by the worker before completion.

acceptance_rate.description: Fraction of offered gigs accepted by the worker. Null if platform does not expose offer data.

on_time_rate.description: Fraction of completed gigs delivered within the committed time window.

financial_health.description: Debt burden, cash-flow stability, and banking behaviour from AA and bureau data.

existing_emi.description: Total monthly EMI outflows across all active loans.

emi_ratio.description: Existing EMI obligations divided by monthly_income_avg. Values above 0.5 indicate high debt burden.

bill_payment_ratio.description: Fraction of utility and subscription bills paid on time in the last 6 months.

cash_flow_stability.description: Ratio of months with positive net cash flow (credits > debits) in the last 6 months.

balance_volatility.description: Standard deviation of daily closing bank balance over the last 90 days.

average_month_end_balance.description: Average bank balance on the last day of each month over the last 3 months. May be negative.

risk_integrity.description: Fraud, identity verification, and regulatory risk signals.

penalty_events.description: Number of platform-issued penalties or suspensions in the last 12 months.

chargebacks.description: Number of successful customer chargebacks against the worker in the last 12 months.

fraud_indicators.description: Number of transactions flagged as anomalous by the AA fraud detection layer in the assessment window.

identity_verified.description: True if government-issued identity (Aadhaar / PAN) has been successfully verified via DigiLocker.

document_verified.description: True if all required income and banking documents have passed automated verification.
